$comment: openMINDS <-> NDI v2 crosswalk: the single machine-readable mapping that both the openMINDS export and import read (did_v2_openminds_import_export_plan.md). Checked by tests/test_veta.py::test_openminds_crosswalk_round_trips, which pins each type's property list to the openMINDS version in `openminds`, so every property has an explicit entry and nothing is silently dropped. `target_kind`: field (a field on the entity) | assertion (a statement about the entity; `ndi_target` is the variable's name as registered in did_v2_term_registry.json, `value_kind` its value; `term_set`, where given, the openMINDS type(s) the values are instances of) | relation (a registered relation, by name; `endpoint` the parent entity type) | global_identifier (rides on entity.global_identifier; a prefix registered in CURIE_lookups_meta.json, or `IRI`) | implied (recoverable from class or relations, not stored per instance) | projection (recomputed from other statements, not stored) | deferred (no v2 home yet; `notes` says whether it needs a term or a decision -- visible, never silently dropped). A note that starts "Open (review of 2026-11-06)" records a question from that review on a row that keeps its target. Rewritten against `latest` as 2.0.0: Jess Haley, 2026-11-06, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [openMINDS crosswalk on latest], [crosswalk assertions registered]. The rows are Proposed (not decided) until the row review (import/export plan, Q1).

openminds.pinned_by: openMINDS_MATLAB v0.12.0 (tag v0.12.0, commit dfd95a168ed8335cca054b241e7a5f7bea4a0de2), NDI-matlab's pin (requirements.txt)
openminds.schema_source: openMetadataInitiative/openMINDS schemas/latest at commit 19412fad8f493ef33f240df4d4109ddb73966f5e; for these five types its property lists equal openMINDS_MATLAB v0.12.0's generated `latest` classes

accessibility.ndi_target: Open or Controlled Data Access Indicator
accessibility.notes: openMINDS `latest` links the Accessibility structure, with 5 required facets: channel, eligibility (AccessEligibilityType), form, paymentModel, process. 1.1.0's term set `ProductAccessibility` (v2.0) is gone. Open (review of 2026-11-06): the registered variable (NCIT:C175887) covers the eligibility facet only, its 2 values (Unrestricted Access, Under Embargo) are not openMINDS eligibility values, and the other 4 facets have no v2 source.

contribution.notes: openMINDS Contribution{contributor (Person | Organization | Consortium), type (ContributionType)}; replaces v2.0 `author`, `custodian` and `otherContribution`. Each contribution edge maps as listed in `contribution_types.edges`, and each CRediT role on a `contributor` edge as listed in `contribution_types.roles`.

contributorAffiliation.notes: openMINDS Affiliation{organization, person}, listed per dataset version. Moved here from Person.affiliation (v4.0), which `latest` no longer has. G108(4) (Jess Haley, 2026-11-06): a person's affiliations are those listed for that person within the dataset. Open: the registered `affiliation` edge is Person -> organization, person-wide; how v2 ties it to one dataset is to check (import/export plan 3.4).

year.notes: a date assertion about the dataset entity, variable schema:copyrightYear (registered "copyrightYear", synonym "copyright year"; T19: an existing term, so no EMPTY term was minted).

customUsageClause.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `customUsageClause` (optional) has no v2 home and was not part of the 2026-11-07 question.

copyright.notes: Jess Haley, 2026-11-07, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [copyright year is a date assertion]: openMINDS Copyright{holder (required), year (required), customUsageClause} is built from the dataset's `copyrightHolder` relation (the holder) and a date assertion about the dataset entity (the year). `parts` maps each Copyright property.

dataType.notes: openMINDS `dataType` (required): "Add all semantic data types (raw, derived and/or simulated) provided in this dataset version." It was `type` in v2.0, which 1.1.0 misread as the object's @type and marked implied. The binding registry row (NCIT:C175886) holds the 4 `openminds:semanticDataType/...` values.

description.notes: openMINDS `description` (required): "Longer statement or account giving the characteristics of someone or something." Carried from 1.1.0. Open (review of 2026-11-06): since 2026-11-01 `notes` is v2's last-resort free-text field, so labelled migration text there would be exported as the description.

documentation.notes: Jess Haley, 2026-11-07, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [documentation from subjectOf]: openMINDS `documentation` (required) is taken from the dataset's `subjectOf` relations to `publication`, `protocol` or `software` entities, each written with that document's `global_identifier`. With none, the export reports documentation missing. The dataset's own DOI stays its `global_identifier` (openMINDS `digitalIdentifier`).

ethicsJurisdiction.notes: openMINDS `ethicsJurisdiction` (required), new in `latest`; v2.0 `ethicsAssessment` has no successor. The registered variable EMPTY:0000359 replaced "ethics assessment" (EMPTY:0000355) on 2026-10-21 (Jess Haley); its binding registry row holds 206 values.

homepage.notes: a URL is an address for the entity it names, so it is one of that entity's global_identifier entries rather than a separate document (did_v2_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 7). Open (review of 2026-11-06): a bare IRI does not say it is the homepage, so it cannot be told apart from a non-NDI repository IRI.

howToCite.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `howToCite` ("Preferred format for citing a particular object or legal person"). 1.1.0 named "how to cite", which is not in the term registry. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `how_to_cite` as text with no registered variable node.

inputData.notes: openMINDS `latest` links DOI | File | FileBundle | WebResource and atlas types. A dataset input is `isBasedOn` -> Data Set and exports as that dataset's DOI. Open (review of 2026-11-06): an input that is a file or a web resource has no registered parent type.

isPrecededBy.notes: successor of v2.0 `isNewVersionOf` (same instruction text). Carried from 1.1.0. Open (review of 2026-11-06): `wasDerivedFrom` is generic provenance, so the export cannot tell a previous version from any other derivation.

isVariantOf.notes: successor of v2.0 `isAlternativeVersionOf`. Carried from 1.1.0. Open (review of 2026-11-06): SIO:000497 means "a subsequent or alternate version", so it overlaps `isPrecededBy`.

isVersionOf.notes: Jess Haley, 2026-11-07, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [one dataset exports as Dataset and version]: one v2 Data Set entity exports as one openMINDS Dataset and one DatasetVersion that `isVersionOf` it, so the link is implied by the same entity and not stored. A dataset-version entity type waits until a dataset has a second release.

keyword.notes: registered as "Keyword" (EDAM:data_0968); 1.1.0 named "keyword". openMINDS `latest` links about 110 controlled-term types plus TermSuggestion. Open (review of 2026-11-06): the export needs an openMINDS instance per keyword term (the term registry's `equivalent` column), and NDI-matlab's generic dataset import writes `keyword` as text (entityDocuments.m).

preparationType.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `preparationType` (links PreparationType, e.g. in vivo, in vitro, ex vivo); new in `latest`.

protocol.notes: the endpoint is `protocol`, the relation's registered parent type (1.1.0 said web_resource, which is not an entity type). EMPTY:0000378 is staged in the term registry, not yet merged in empty-ontology.

publicationStatus.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `publicationStatus` (links PublicationStatus: the lifecycle state of the resource, e.g. published).

repository.notes: a URL is an address for the entity it names, so it is one of that entity's global_identifier entries rather than a separate document (did_v2_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 7). NDI Cloud copies are `ndicloud:<id>`; any other repository is its IRI. Open (review of 2026-11-06): openMINDS FileRepository requires IRI, hostedBy and name, which have no v2 source, and `ndicloud` has no uri_base to build the IRI from.

shortName.notes: registered as "Abbreviation" (NCIT:C42610, "A shortened form of a word or phrase"), which NDI-matlab's generic dataset import already writes for a dataset's `short_name` (entityDocuments.m); 1.1.0 named "short name", which is not registered.

studiedSpecimen.notes: the studied subjects, recomputed from the dataset's sessions (`isPartOf` -> Data Set) and their subject entities, not restated here (1.1.0 named the relation `part_of`). Exported once the subject types are in the crosswalk (import/export plan, stage 2).

studyTarget.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `studyTarget` ("Structure or function that was targeted within a study"; links species, cell types, anatomical and stimulus terms) has no v2 home. It could be a projection from the subjects' term assertions, or a dataset assertion with a new variable.

supportChannel.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `supportChannel` ("Way of communication used to interact with users or customers", an array of strings). 1.1.0 named "support channel", which is not in the term registry. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `support_channel` as text with no registered variable node.

technique.notes: openMINDS `technique` (required). The binding registry row (NCIT:C16847) holds 227 values, 224 of them `openminds:technique/...`.

usageCondition.notes: openMINDS `usageCondition` (successor of v2.0 `license`) links License{fullName, legalCode, shortName} | UsageAgreement objects, not terms. The dataset's License assertion (NCIT:C43611, registered) is the source; how the export builds the License object from the term (e.g. an `spdx:` value) is open (review of 2026-11-06).

versionIdentifier.notes: registered as "version number" (IAO:0000129), which NDI-matlab's generic dataset import and software entities already write (entityDocuments.m, +migrate/+internal/softwareEntity.m); 1.1.0 named "version", which is not registered.

versionSpecification.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `versionSpecification` (required; "a short description (or summary) of the novelties/peculiarities of this research product version"), the successor of v2.0 `versionInnovation`. 1.1.0 named "version innovation", which is not in the term registry. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `version_innovation` as text with no registered variable node.

alternateName.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS Person `alternateName` ("any other known full name of this person"). 1.1.0 named "alternate name", which is not registered. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `alternate_name` as text with no registered variable node.

associatedAccount.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `associatedAccount` (new in v3.0; links AccountInformation: web service accounts held by the person) has no v2 home. An account URL could be a global_identifier IRI, but AccountInformation also requires the service.

contactInformation.notes: openMINDS ContactInformation{email (required)}. Registered as "E-mail Address" (NCIT:C42775), which NDI-matlab's generic dataset import already writes for `email` (entityDocuments.m); 1.1.0 named "email", which is not registered.

preferredName.notes: openMINDS `preferredName` (required): "the person's preferred way to write their name in a professional context". The entity's `name` is the display name ('Jess Haley'), which Person requires (entity_type_bindings).

acronym.notes: successor of v2.0 `shortName`. An acronym is "a shortened form of a word or phrase" (Abbreviation, NCIT:C42610, registered); 1.1.0 named "short name", which is not registered.

alternateName.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS Organization `alternateName` ("any other known name or acronym of this organization").

countryOfFormation.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `countryOfFormation` (required; links SovereignState). The sovereign-state values are registered (as the values of `ethics jurisdiction`), the variable is not.

hasParent.notes: org hierarchy, kept distinct from subject/session part_of.

homepage.notes: a URL is an address for the entity it names, so it is one of that entity's global_identifier entries rather than a separate document (did_v2_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 7).

jurisdiction.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS Organization `jurisdiction` (links SovereignState | SupranationalBody: the jurisdiction under which the organization operates).

location.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `location` links a Location structure (the headquarters). "Location" (NCIT:C25341) is registered, but how a structured address is stored on an organization is not decided.

membership.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `membership` links Membership records (one per member). The registered `member of` relation's parent type is Group only, not organization.

type.notes: needs a term: openMINDS Organization `type` (required; links OrganizationType, e.g. university, research institute) has no registered variable. The entity's own `type` is `organization`; a finer kind would be one term assertion (T1).

acknowledgement.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS Funding `acknowledgement` ("Official declaration or avowal of appreciation of an act or achievement"; in every openMINDS version).

awardNumber.notes: an award number is unique only within its funder, so it is not a global identifier: a grant DOI goes in global_identifier when there is one, otherwise the number is the funding entity's local_identifier (did_v2_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 6).

funder.notes: openMINDS `funder` (required) is an Organization or a Person. Open (review of 2026-11-06): the registered `funder` edge's parent type is organization only, so a person funder cannot be stored.

accessibility.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `accessibility` (required) links the Accessibility structure. The registered `Open or Controlled Data Access Indicator` binding is scoped to a Data Set, and software has no accessibility statement.

contribution.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `contribution` (required). the registered `author` / `contributor` relation's child type is Data Set only, so a software entity cannot carry it. The registered `producer` edge (software -> organization) is one kind of contribution, with no contribution type.

contributorAffiliation.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `contributorAffiliation` follows `contribution`, which has no v2 home for software.

copyright.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS Copyright{holder, year} (both required). the registered `copyrightHolder` relation's child type is Data Set only, so a software entity cannot carry it. The year has no home (see DatasetVersion.copyright).

dependency.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `dependency` links Dependency records (other software versions this one depends on). No registered relation between software entities.

description.notes: openMINDS `description` (required): "Longer statement or account giving the characteristics of someone or something." Carried from 1.1.0. Open (review of 2026-11-06): since 2026-11-01 `notes` is v2's last-resort free-text field, so labelled migration text there would be exported as the description.

digitalIdentifier.notes: DOI or SWHID (`swh`, also registered), whichever the source supplies.

documentation.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `documentation` (required) links DOI | File | ISBN | WebResource. 1.1.0 mapped the v2.0 `fullDocumentation` to relation `subjectOf` -> web_resource, but `web_resource` is not an entity type and `subjectOf`'s registered parents are protocol, publication and software. A documenting publication could be `subjectOf` -> publication; a file or web page has no registered home.

funding.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `funding`. the registered `funding` relation's child type is Data Set only, so a software entity cannot carry it.

homepage.notes: populated by the app->software fold from the v1 app.url.

howToCite.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `howToCite` ("Preferred format for citing a particular object or legal person"). 1.1.0 named "how to cite", which is not in the term registry. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `how_to_cite` as text with no registered variable node.

implements.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `implements` links InterfaceVersion (the interfaces this software version implements). No v2 home.

inputFormat.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `inputFormat` (links ContentType: the data formats the software reads).

isPrecededBy.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `isPrecededBy` (the preceding software version). The Data Set row uses `wasDerivedFrom`, which has no type limits, but a previous software version is not provenance; not decided.

isVariantOf.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `isVariantOf`. the registered `is version of` relation's child type is Data Set only, so a software entity cannot carry it.

isVersionOf.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `isVersionOf` (required) links the version-independent Software. v2's software entity is "a program, at a version", with no separate version-independent entity (see DatasetVersion.isVersionOf).

keyword.notes: registered as "Keyword" (EDAM:data_0968); 1.1.0 named "keyword". openMINDS `latest` links about 110 controlled-term types plus TermSuggestion. Open (review of 2026-11-06): the export needs an openMINDS instance per keyword term (the term registry's `equivalent` column), and NDI-matlab's generic dataset import writes `keyword` as text (entityDocuments.m).

language.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `language` (links Language: the human languages the software supports).

operatingDevice.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `operatingDevice` (links OperatingDevice: the devices the software runs on).

operatingSystem.notes: openMINDS means the SUPPORTED os, which the entity does not store. The per-RUN os is captured on the calculation instead: its `operating_system_id` edge names the os as a `software` document (#73 item 53) -- a property of the run, not of the software. Open (review of 2026-11-06): no stored statement means "supported os", so on export this property is empty.

outputFormat.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `outputFormat` (links ContentType: the data formats the software writes).

programmingLanguage.notes: likewise per-run: the calculation's `interpreter_id` edge names the interpreter as a `software` document (#73 item 53). Open (review of 2026-11-06): the interpreter of one run is not the language the software is written in, so on export this property is empty.

publicationStatus.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `publicationStatus` (links PublicationStatus: the lifecycle state of the resource, e.g. published).

relatedPublication.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `relatedPublication`. the registered `citation` relation's child type is Data Set only, so a software entity cannot carry it. `subjectOf` (child any entity, parent publication) is a candidate.

releaseDate.notes: needs a decision: openMINDS `releaseDate` (required). The registered "release date" (EMPTY:0000346) is defined as "The date on which a dataset was released for use", so using it for software would widen its definition.

repository.notes: same URL scheme as homepage; the two are distinguished by the stored value, not by separate slots. Open (review of 2026-11-06): so the export cannot tell them apart, and FileRepository's required hostedBy and name have no source.

scope.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `scope` (required; links SoftwareApplicationCategory, SoftwareFeature, Technique and other terms: the extent of the software).

shortName.notes: the entity keeps ONE name field; per its own documentation software.name carries the fullName/shortName pair. A separate short form would be a coordinate, not a thing (T13). Open (review of 2026-11-06): both are required in `latest`, so a round trip cannot return both (the DatasetVersion row uses Abbreviation).

supportChannel.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `supportChannel` ("Way of communication used to interact with users or customers", an array of strings). 1.1.0 named "support channel", which is not in the term registry. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `support_channel` as text with no registered variable node.

usageCondition.notes: openMINDS `usageCondition` (successor of v2.0 `license`) links License{fullName, legalCode, shortName} | UsageAgreement objects, not terms. The software's License assertion (NCIT:C43611, registered) is the source; how the export builds the License object from the term (e.g. an `spdx:` value) is open (review of 2026-11-06).

versionIdentifier.notes: registered as "version number" (IAO:0000129), the variable NDI-matlab's software entities already write (+migrate/+internal/softwareEntity.m); 1.1.0 named "version".

versionSpecification.notes: needs a term: no registered variable for openMINDS `versionSpecification` (required; "a short description (or summary) of the novelties/peculiarities of this research product version"), the successor of v2.0 `versionInnovation`. 1.1.0 named "version innovation", which is not in the term registry. NDI-matlab's generic dataset import (+ndi/+setup/+V2/entityDocuments.m) writes `version_innovation` as text with no registered variable node.

contribution_types.$comment: how a v2 contribution edge becomes an openMINDS Contribution{contributor, type} on export, and back on import. `edges`: what each registered contribution relation (Data Set -> Person | organization) exports as. `roles`: each value of directed_relation.roles (`did_contributor_role`: the 14 CRediT roles and `corresponding author`) on a `contributor` edge, with the openMINDS ContributionType instance it exports as (openMINDS_instances `instances/latest/terminologies/contributionType/`, read at a6efd17c3502abfed94da74916e65b02b4443afa), and `match`: exact or close by definition (no openMINDS instance cross-references CRediT). The mapped openMINDS types are all different, so the import recovers the role. A role with `export: false` is left out of the export and reported as not exported. Drafted from the review of 2026-11-06 (G108(2), "Draft it"); the pairings are Proposed (not decided) until the row review.

author.notes: the author list, as one ordered authoring contribution, in the edge's order (import/export plan 3.4). The registered `author` edge's parent type is Person only, so an organization or consortium author has no edge.

contributor.notes: one openMINDS Contribution per CRediT role on the edge, typed as listed in `roles`.

maintainer.notes: Jess Haley, 2026-11-07, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [custodian exports as custodianship]: a dataset's `maintainer` relation exports as an openMINDS contribution of type custodianship.

roles.notes: not exported: no openMINDS contribution type matches. Decided by Jess Haley, 2026-11-06, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [unmapped roles not exported]: leave it out of the export and report it as not exported (not the generic `authoring`). Nearest: design, research, leadership; none is about formulating the research goals.
`processing` is broader (any transformation); openMINDS has no analysis-only type.
not `funding`, which is the funder providing the money.
covers data collection; "performing the experiments" is closer to `execution`.
direction differs: openMINDS `provision` makes the target available, CRediT supplies inputs to the research. Alternative: `acquisition`.
CRediT includes leadership, which openMINDS has separately as `leadership`.
CRediT means reproducibility; openMINDS means meeting requirements.

not exported: no openMINDS contribution type matches. Decided by Jess Haley, 2026-11-06, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [unmapped roles not exported]: leave it out of the export and report it as not exported (not the generic `authoring`). Nearest: authoring, which is the ordered author contribution, so mapping to it would make every visualizer an author.
no "initial draft" sense; translation is not covered.
not a CRediT role, and not exported: G108(3) (Jess Haley, 2026-11-06, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [openMINDS export answers]): "Drop it". Nearest openMINDS type: `liaison`.
